responsibility: This file implements option suggestion and completion support on top of GCC’s generated option tables. It lazily builds a cache of candidate spellings from cl_options, enum-valued options, sanitizer suboptions, and target-provided valid option values, then uses spellchecking to suggest the closest recognized option for unknown input and to enumerate prefix matches for the driver’s shell-completion mode, with selftests covering valid, partial, and garbage completions.
same_name_distinction: Implements option_proposer from opt-suggestions.h by building the cached suggestion/completion candidate list from cl_options, cl_enums, sanitizer options, and target hooks, and by running the lookup/completion algorithms plus selftests. Unlike the header, it contains the data-population logic and behavior behind suggestion and completion requests.
